what:
costs_ab.py OLD NEW OUT.json [ROUNDS]: the neighbor search's own costs before and after the single-pass packing.

Two builds of the costs test of omnimd-gpu (tests/costs.rs), whose `neighbor_search_costs` runs a NeighborSearch
3,000 times back to back after 100 to warm up (`issue`: the host's pace, packing included) and 3,000 times with a
wait for the device after each (`with a sync`: packing, upload, kernel and the wait), for 88 atoms of four types at
the density of hydroxyapatite and the same replicated 2 and 4 times along each axis (704 and 5,632), cutoff 6 A.
Alternated in ROUNDS rounds (7) in one session, the order reversed every other round; the build before twice a round
(`before again`: what the machine adds). The least and the median of each.
affinity: Every process held to logical processors 2 to 15, the performance cores of the i9-14900K but the first (a Python wrapper sets the affinity of the script, and the programs it starts inherit it): run by the scheduler, the host side of a run lands on performance or efficiency cores, which differ by 1.5 to 2 times in the packing alone.

builds.after: tests/costs.rs of this change (the single-pass packing)
